scope: Read-only application diagnosis only; no live profile, encrypted user record, service, test or source mutation.
finding: restoreRecords currently rejects any differing ciphertext at the same key, even when both authenticated values are identical. journal-record.write creates fresh payload and recovery-descriptor IVs each time. Both preference readers write during read/recovery, including completed reads; this supports a source-level reopening-conflict mechanism, not attribution of the particular full-backup failure.
recommendedImplementation: Retain incoming authentication, descriptor framing, wallet ownership, exact storageKey and size/duplicate checks. Extend the private authenticate helper to retain descriptor and decrypted value for internal comparison only; do not expose them in logs or exports.

For a present different ciphertext, independently authenticate the local envelope using the same wallet and key. Require identical canonical descriptor keyDomain/scopeText, then accept full decrypted-value equality while preserving local ciphertext. Conservative JSON.stringify equality of entire parsed values is enough for fresh-IV rewrites; never compare only selected status/hash fields or discard revision/intent metadata.

For the exact allowlist ROLLING_PREFERENCES_V1 and ROLLING_COLD_PREFERENCES_V1 only, differing authenticated local cache may be preserved. Incoming cache must still authenticate; corrupt local cannot be silently replaced. This is local preservation, not merge, newer-wins inference or authoritative completeness.

All other domains remain financial/intent-bearing: different decrypted payloads fail closed in either direction. Missing local keys still restore the authenticated incoming records by existing null compare-and-swap; newer unknown backup intent must never be silently skipped.

Keep validation of the complete input before writes. Capture observed local bytes and the skip/install decision; re-read before applying each decision and reject a concurrent change. Preserve existing null CAS/readback and partial-restoration resumability. No journal schema or global workflow redesign required.

domainAssessment.ordinaryPreferenceValidation: Full owner/network/class scope, canonical checkpoint, trusted node and contract class; fold digest/terminal revision and canonical read markers; pre/post write rechecks. Cache carries derived selections, not signed transaction intent.
domainAssessment.coldPreferenceValidation: Exact class/artifact/proof-policy/tier scope; database/epoch/sequence/mailbox continuity, canonical anchors and terminal fold digest. Missing/incompatible predecessor restarts reconstruction; complete UI only after full validation.

existingImportSemantics: shared/account.js restores claims and journals under existing recovery lock before activating prepared wallet. Empty arrays do not restore records. No account.js change is needed for the narrow ciphertext/cache policy. Keys-only import must remain available and must not clear current records.
focusedRegressionRecommendations: Same financial decrypted value encrypted twice with distinct payload/descriptor IVs: restore succeeds with byte-identical local record retained.
Different financial status/nonce/intent/signed bytes/cap/claim custody in either backup direction: rejection before any input writes; unknown intent not hidden.
Both exact cache domains: differing valid local cache retained; duplicate, foreign owner, wrong scope/key/domain, corrupt incoming or corrupt local rejected.
Actual preference reader read-after-export changes ciphertext; import succeeds and next reader still revalidates canonical anchor/database epoch and never publishes stale partial totals.
Concurrent local ciphertext replacement between validation and commit fails closed; missing-record CAS behavior unchanged.
Mixed cache plus conflicting financial input rejects the whole validation phase without cache deletion or financial overwrite.
qualification: Actual original full-export failure remains unexplained until owner performs authorized offline private snapshot comparison. Do not label it fixed from source reasoning alone.
